title: Canonical finite free sheaf duality transposes matrix components
statement: Let X be a scheme, I,J finite types, and phi:O_X^(J) -> O_X^(I) a sheaf morphism. For i in I and j in J the (j,i) component of homObjFreeUnitIso(I)^-1 followed by precomposition with phi followed by homObjFreeUnitIso(J) equals the (i,j) component of phi, as endomorphisms of O_X. Coordinate inclusions are the coproduct inclusions and coordinate projections are identity on the chosen summand and zero on the others. This includes empty types and the zero ring.

source.place: Tag 01HV(4)-(5) and functoriality; finite free evaluation calculation in duality.tex, Tag 0BQZ. Explicit matrix-component calculation written by X2 from the definitions.

proof.text: Expand homObjFreeIso into the opposite-functor biproduct comparison and the unit-Hom comparison. The coproduct-to-biproduct comparison identifies the chosen inclusions and projections. The defining projection and injection identities of opMapBiproductIso turn the component of the dual map into the unit dual comparison conjugating precomposition with the original matrix component.

A unit endomorphism is determined on every open by its value at 1. The inverse unit-Hom comparison sends 1 to the identity functional; precomposition and evaluation send it to the same value at 1 as the original endomorphism. Unit sections restrict 1 to 1. Thus the conjugated component is the original component. Empty index types are vacuous and no nonzero scalar is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem freeSheafDualTranspose_component {X : Scheme.{u}} {I J : Type u}
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (phi : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J ⟶ SheafOfModules.free I)
    (i : I) (j : J) :
    SheafOfModules.ιFree i ≫ (SheafOfModules.homObjFreeUnitIso I).inv ≫
      SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) phi
        (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) ≫
      (SheafOfModules.homObjFreeUnitIso J).hom ≫ Scheme.Modules.freeπ j =
    SheafOfModules.ιFree j ≫ phi ≫ Scheme.Modules.freeπ i
